profile.research_note: Multiple sources found for a 'Microsoft' presence in Guaynabo, Puerto Rico describe a Microsoft Caribbean Inc. regional business/sales office rather than a data center (directory listings variously describe it as a 'Business Center' or even mislabel it as a computer hardware store). No source found during this research indicates server or IT infrastructure at this location. Puerto Rico Data Center Map (dcmap.us) lists only 3 facilities tracked for the whole territory and does not corroborate a Microsoft-operated data center among them. Flagged as a likely non-data-center facility (regional office, not a computing facility) for review during registry cleanup, consistent with policy against deleting rows outright.

reading.body:
This entry describes a Microsoft office in Guaynabo, Puerto Rico, not a data center. Research across business directories, the Puerto Rico Data Center Map, and operator sources found no evidence of server infrastructure or IT facilities at this location, only a regional sales and business office.

Puerto Rico has one mapped facility in this database, which is this office. The territory publishes no megawatt capacity figures from any operator, which means there is no basis to rank this location or any other Puerto Rico site by compute infrastructure.

This campus does not matter to AI scaling. It is a regional business office, not a computing facility, and should not be read as part of the deployed data center estate.
